## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      4 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 13 авг. 2026 г. - 22 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Leemiz_, 22 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Every three clicks on the app prompts it asking me to buy premium. No. I don’t want it and clicking so all the time is very very annoying"
            2. _Vadim Belenky_, 20 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "too much ads and too much push towards the premium. Data on food is not reliable. Considering alternatives!!!"
            3. _Derrick Wilson_, 20 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "I tried to cancel the subscription & it's not allowing me to remove the auto renewal & will not show up in my subscription to cancel."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      5 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 6 мая 2026 г. - 23 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Vipul Uchil_, 23 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "app is more or less unusable after the latest update, which is definitely vibe coded because some MBA decided to fire all the UX professionals at the company. they took a perfectly intuitive and functional app and destroyed it for no reason at all. the new app is not user friendly in any way, actively prevents you from finding information, prevents you from quickly logging food. why would you ever use a food logging app when it takes you forever to log a single item of food? use cronometer."
            2. _enka cacka_, 21 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "broken app, checkout doesnt work, guided onboarding flashing and annoying, cant add a meal adds pop up and screen freeze. what a joke"
            3. _Jen,seeking resolution_, 17 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Terrible navigation, continually have Mondays entries end up on the following Sunday, no longer is there mass delete, various editing functions gone, way more clicks to add and delete, hideous UI and UX, glitchy. Did anyone bother to even do a feature gap analysis before deploying this junk that has had nothing but terrible reviews none of which have they remedied or even addressed? Boycot these people"
<!--/ir-theme-->
